episodes.synopsis: The Service Club’s new task is to help Tobecchi find a way to confess his true feelings to Ebino, but she’s got a different agenda in mind, and it includes Hachiman.
episodes.title: No One Knows Why They Came to the Service Club

episodes.synopsis: The field trip in Kyoto continues, with the Service Club trying their best to help solve their problems. Later, Hachiman makes a surprising realization.
episodes.title: His and Her Confessions Reached No One

episodes.synopsis: The tension between Yukino and Hachiman is thick enough to cut with a knife. Meanwhile, Kaker is planning something for Hina.
episodes.title: Quietly, Yukinoshita Yukino Makes a Decision

episodes.synopsis: Hachiman ends up in an awkward situation with Orimoto, while still searching for the solution to the student election prank. However, a resolution is closer than he thinks.
episodes.title: And Yuigahama Yui Makes a Declaration

episodes.synopsis: Hachiman has yet to figure out how to fix the student council president election problem. But a discussion with his sister finally gives him the ability to take action.
episodes.title: In That Room, There is No Longer the Scent of Tea

episodes.synopsis: After the student council election, Hachiman has his reservations as to whether he made the right choice as the new president struggles with her first event.
episodes.title: Without Incident, the Congress Dances, But Does Not Progress

episodes.synopsis: Iroha’s first event as president isn’t going well. All of the people on the partnering student council just want to look smart, but can’t actually make decisions!
episodes.title: Even So, That Room Continues to Play Out the Endless Days

episodes.synopsis: After Hachiman and Yukino’s conversation, Hachiman is left contemplating the faults in his thinking. Ms. Hiratsuka offers him a car ride and her advice on the matter.
episodes.title: Even Still, Hachiman Hikigaya is…

episodes.synopsis: Ms. Hiratsuka gives the trio and Iroha tickets a theme park and tells them to discover what Christmas really means.
episodes.title: And, Yukino Yukinoshita is…

episodes.synopsis: It will take all three members of the Service Club to fix the disastrous Christmas event. After, Yui and Hachiman head out to pick a present for Yukino’s birthday.
episodes.title: The Thing That the Light in Each of Their Hands Illuminates

episodes.synopsis: While the group attempts to figure out what their respective future plans are, a rumor is sparked regarding Yukino and Hayama that makes the whole school curious.
episodes.title: Hayato Hayama Always Lives Up to Expectations

episodes.synopsis: With the approach of Valentine’s Day, the Service Club is overwhelmed with requests regarding chocolate. In an attempt to solve the issue, Hachiman concocts a sweet plan.
episodes.title: Still, The Thing He Desires Is Out of Reach, And He Continues to Mistake What’s Real

episodes.synopsis: An awkward visit from Yukino’s sister causes Yukino to spend the night at Yui’s. But when only Yui seems able to make up her mind, the Service Club may never be the same.
episodes.title: Spring Always Comes to Life Buried Underneath a Pile of Snow
